notes.title: Patch 1.05: Added escape methods, the truth of the incident
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.05: Added escape methods, the truth of the incident[/b]

- A new escape method other than the front door has been added.
When score points are 90 or more, the iron fence of the sewer will be removed, and you can go to the rose garden by proceeding from there.

- The truth of the incident
By escaping from a side other than the front door and answering the culprit correctly, you can read an article written by the protagonist about the truth of the incident.

- Coyote Time
When the player falls while moving, jump input is now accepted in the air for a short grace period.
This makes it a little harder to fall.

- Other memo-related bug fixes
A bug where memo No. 46 could not be closed properly when trying to close it with the Esc key, and the contents of the memo have been slightly fixed.

notes.title: ■Patch 1.04 Added character reasoning notes
notes.content:
- Added character reasoning notes function.
This should make it easier to understand all the characters and their relationships.

- After obtaining the front door key, you can only return via the elevator on the 4th floor.

- Descriptions are now displayed when starting the game, when you first open the notepad, and when you first open the options screen.

- Reduced the overall light source strength to prevent overexposure.

- Changed the color of the buttons inside the elevator from white to black.

- Fixed an issue that allowed wine glasses to be used on a campfire that was already out.

notes.title: パッチ1.02 オートセーブの追加
notes.content:
パッチ1.02 オートセーブの追加

・オートセーブ機能が追加されました。
・一階広場の机の高さを低くしました。その他オブジェクトのサイズを微調整しました。
・プレイヤーランタンの光源の位置を高くしました。これによって不自然に影になってしまい見えにくくなってしまっていた現象が改善されました。

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.02[/b]

Fixes
Changed drawing of candle fire
Changed the position of sleeping pills
Fixed a problem in which footsteps did not sound unless the body was more than half on the ground.
The light of the search assist for the attic key has been widened so that it can be seen from the outside.
Changed the contents of memo No.28 and memo No.45.
Added new memo No. 46.
Added playing cards and the accompanying puzzle-solving gimmick.

notes.title: Patch1.01
notes.content:
[b]Patch1.01[/b]

Fixes
The name of each gramophone when hovering the cursor over it has been changed from “gramophone” to “first gramophone” or “second gramophone”.
When the mystery of the jewelry cabinet is solved, the sound when the lock is opened was not clear enough.
The contents of memo No. 43 were corrected.
The unscrewing of a screw was not saved.
The piano keyboard is now illuminated when the search assist function is used.
